description: This file defines the MailMerge class, which handles document generation and mail merging functionalities within the SuiteCRM project. It manages data sources, document templates, and the process of creating merged documents with Microsoft Word via COM automation.

classes.name: MailMerge
classes.description: A class responsible for managing mail merge operations, including creating header files, data sources, and final documents using Word automation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailMerge object with optional list, fieldList, and data directory parameters.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Performs the mail merge process if the list is non-empty, creating documents based on the provided template.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Sets the template used for mail merging.

methods.name: CleanUp
methods.description: Removes temporary files and directories created during the mail merge process.

methods.name: CreateHeaderFile
methods.description: Creates a header file in Word for the mail merge, including field labels.

methods.name: CreateDataSource
methods.description: Generates a data source document in Word with the list data.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Executes the mail merge by opening the template, linking data sources, and saving the merged document.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the COM Word application and sets up necessary directories.

methods.name: SetDataList
methods.description: Sets the data list for the mail merge.

methods.name: SetFieldList
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to be included in the mail merge.
